children: The current sharp increase in U.K. government bond yields, or gilt yields, raises the risk of new tax rises at this year's budget on Oct. 28, Ebury's Matthew Ryan says in a note. Ten-year yields hit 5.294% on Wednesday, a 19-year high, LSEG data show. Thirty-year gilt yields climb to 5.921%, their highest since 1998. "This rise in yields, which will eat directly into the government's fiscal headroom, raises the risk of tax hikes in the autumn," he says. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
